correct_answer: Yes — as a pre-merge West campus student with continuous enrollment, the West campus policy (no time limit) applies per the transition memorandum; however, the petition must go to the Academic Standards Committee, not the Associate Registrar.
rationale: The transition memorandum (Section 4.1) explicitly states pre-Fall 2021 admits retain their admitting campus regulations during continuous enrollment. Jordan was admitted Fall 2020 at West campus and has maintained continuous enrollment. The resolved comment thread confirms this provision was never formally sunset — the VP acknowledged legal obligation to maintain it until formal supersession with notice. The West campus policy has no time limit but requires Academic Standards Committee approval (not Associate Registrar). The Google Sheet precedent in Row 112 confirms this exact framework was applied to another pre-merge student as recently as March 2025. Answer A incorrectly applies the unified policy without considering the transition memorandum's grandfathering provision. Answer C correctly identifies the applicable policy framework but misapplies the approval authority — the West policy specifies Academic Standards Committee, and the 'more favorable' clause in the transition memo applies to the substantive regulation (no time limit = more favorable), not the approval pathway. The Associate Registrar authority in AR-2023-07 doesn't override the committee requirement from the West policy. Answer D conflates the procedural path — grade appeals and retroactive withdrawals are different processes with different outcomes and standards.
